main.description: Send a previously created draft by id (post human approval). The draft was created either via ai.gftd.apps.microsoft.sendMail (auto-draft for external recipients) or directly in Outlook.

fromUpn.description: Mailbox UPN that owns the draft. Defaults to env DEFAULT_SENDER_UPN when omitted.

draftId.description: Graph message id returned by sendMail (status=drafted).
